notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) HTTP fetch (curl_cffi impersonate chrome120) got 403 Forbidden (Cloudflare) on robots.txt, homepage, and sitemap.xml on both www and bare domain. Tier (b) Playwright headless chromium also got 403 on homepage load. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome (real browser session) reached the live site successfully (site redirects to https://thebowerycompany.com/en/, a Magento storefront) - used for the full research pass. robots.txt (read via Chrome, since direct fetch was blocked) has no Disallow for anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-* and no blanket Disallow:/, so tier (c) was permitted. TREE: built from https://thebowerycompany.com/media/sitemap/category_sitemap.xml (full category URL list) cross-checked against the homepage/global nav (New In, Furniture, Outdoor, Accessories, Books & Magazines, Wall Arts, Lighting, Textiles - confirmed via /en/outdoor page's nav strip). Every candidate Textile/Storage node was opened individually; h1 and canonical were checked via document.querySelector to confirm the node matched the requested URL (guards against silent parent/sibling fallback). QTY: read from the Magento toolbar '.toolbar-amount' element via JS (e.g. 'Items 121-131 of 131' or 'N Items') on each node's own listing page - this is the site's own exact count, not paginated-and-counted manually (used only as a cross-check on the Rugs category, which matched: page 7/7 last page showed items 121-131 of 131). EXCLUDED (dead/empty nav branches with 0 products, confirmed via 'We can't find products matching the selection' or empty toolbar-amount): /furniture/textile + /furniture/textile/kitchenware (0 items, duplicate of textiles/kitchenware which is live), /accessories-home/textile + /accessories-home/textile/kitchenware (0 items), /accessories-home/shelves (redirects to homepage - dead) + /accessories-home/shelves/shelving-systems (0 items), /accessories-home/on-the-go/bags (0 items, also not home-storage even if populated), /lightings/cord-sets/textiles (0 items; also not a home-textile product even if populated - lamp cord covering). EXCLUDED (non-qualifying content despite plausible name): /textiles/hammocks (0 items; hammocks are not an enumerated textile category and are furniture/leisure-adjacent), /furniture/outdoors/outdoor-textiles (1 item, but the actual product is 'Staffa Outdoor Pedestal' - a furniture plant stand mis-filed under this slug, not a textile product - excluded by primary-product-type rule), /accessories-home/decoration-accessories/bins (2 items, both 'Office Bin' waste/trash bins - not storage/organization products per storage.md, excluded), all of /furniture/storage-furniture/* (cabinets, storage-systems, drawers, dressers, highboards, headboards, sideboards, vitrines) - explicitly placed under the Furniture path by the site's own hierarchy, so treated as Furniture per storage.md Sec21/27, out of scope for this Storage extraction. PARENT/CHILD DEDUP: /accessories-home/storage-furniture (h1 'Storage Accessories') shows 1 direct item on its own listing page, which is the exact same product ('Paper Pulp Box Set of 2 Small') as its only child /accessories-home/storage-furniture/storage-systems (also 1 item) - confirmed these are the same aggregate, so the parent URL/qty was NOT recorded (kept as grouping row only) and only the child leaf was recorded, per the parent-URL rule. LOW-CONFIDENCE: 'Racks' (accessories-home/decoration-accessories/racks, 9 items - HAY Colour Rack / Knit wall coat-hook racks and a Ferm Living wall rack) marked confidence MEDIUM: these are wall-mounted coat/clothes racks, which storage.md Sec19 explicitly lists as Storage ('Clothes Racks'), but they are presented in a design-forward/decorative style, so flagged for review rather than treated as clear-cut HIGH.
